# Only an OpenAPI 3 document is read. A Swagger 2.0 one, or a document with
# no version at all, is an error at the import.
env SNGL_GENCACHE=off

! sngl check swagger.sngl
stderr 'swagger.sngl:1:1: import "openapi:./swagger.yml": .*a Swagger 2.0 document: only OpenAPI 3 is read'

! sngl check bare.sngl
stderr 'bare.sngl:1:1: import "openapi:./bare.yml": .*not an OpenAPI document: it has no `openapi` version'

! sngl check four.sngl
stderr 'four.sngl:1:1: import "openapi:./four.yml": .*OpenAPI 4.0.0: only OpenAPI 3 is read'

-- swagger.sngl --
import api "openapi:./swagger.yml"

const x = 1
-- bare.sngl --
import api "openapi:./bare.yml"

const x = 1
-- four.sngl --
import api "openapi:./four.yml"

const x = 1
-- swagger.yml --
swagger: "2.0"
info: {title: T, version: "1"}
paths: {}
-- bare.yml --
info: {title: T, version: "1"}
paths: {}
-- four.yml --
openapi: 4.0.0
info: {title: T, version: "1"}
paths: {}
